Which times tables are taught in primary school?

Year 2: 2, 5 and 10

Build multiplication and division facts for these tables. Counting in 3s is also included in the curriculum.

Year 3: 3, 4 and 8

Practise the new tables while retaining the 2, 5 and 10 facts learned earlier.

Year 4: through 12 × 12

Consolidate every table and its related division facts. Years 5 and 6 use them in harder calculations.

How the game checks times table recall.

A correct multiplication answer does not automatically count as a correct division answer. Coach records both, limits new fact families in a short match and returns to facts on later days. A table becomes secure when all its multiplication and related division facts have enough independent recall evidence.
